title: Maximum Running Time of N Computers
goal: Run n computers simultaneously for as long as possible by swapping batteries.
strategy: For a target runtime, each battery contributes at most that runtime because it cannot power two computers at once. Feasibility is total capped energy at least n times the target.

edgeCases: One computer can consume every battery in sequence
Exactly one battery per computer is limited by the smallest
